name: Settlement Transaction Condition 3 Code
definition: Specifies the conditions under which the order/trade is to be settled.

ASGN.name: Assignement
ASGN.definition: Transfer of ownership of the asset to another party during the closing of an option.

CLEN.name: Clean
CLEN.definition: Tax-exempt financial instruments are to be settled.

DIRT.name: Dirty
DIRT.definition: Taxable financial instruments are to be settled.

DLWM.name: Delivery Without Matching
DLWM.definition: Matching receipt instruction not required (only for concerned international or national central securities depositories).

DRAW.name: Drawn
DRAW.definition: Settlement transactions relates to drawn securities.

EXER.name: Exercised
EXER.definition: Settlement transaction relates to options, futures or derivatives that are exercised.

FRCL.name: Free Clean Settlement
FRCL.definition: Delivery will be made free of payment but a clean payment order will be sent.

KNOC.name: Knocked Out
KNOC.definition: Settlement transaction relates to options, futures or derivatives that are expired worthless.

PHYS.name: Physical
PHYS.definition: Securities are to be physically settled.

RESI.name: Residual
RESI.definition: Relates to transaction on a security that is not eligible at the Central Security Depository (CSD) but for which the payment will be enacted by the central securities depository.

SPDL.name: Special Delivery
SPDL.definition: Settlement transactions to be settled with special delivery.

SPST.name: Split Settlement
SPST.definition: Money and financial instruments settle in different locations.

UNEX.name: Unexposed
UNEX.definition: Delivery cannot be performed until money is received.
